purpose: Professional handoff briefs for the three provisional detailed-design areas.
claim_boundary: Participant-authored operating contract only. It defines role types, records, pause conditions, and evidence needed for later professional work. It does not name real institutions, certify products, authorize treatment, approve construction, or claim field performance.

areas.role_in_system_zh: 整机故障复现、车队接口与安全回归复测
areas.role_in_system_en: Whole-system fault reproduction, fleet interfaces, and safety regression retest
areas.acceptance_definition: Repeatable declared regression evidence; no release authority by this area alone.
areas.no_go_trigger: Unsafe isolation, failed emergency stop, uncontrolled route, or missing responsible operator.
areas.pause_resume: Pause the test yard; resume only after correction, new drill, and independent review.

areas.role_in_system_zh: 互换件证据、科研仪器校准、协议与技能
areas.role_in_system_en: Interchangeable-part evidence, instrument calibration, protocols, and skills
areas.acceptance_definition: All required dimensions recorded; fail and pending remain valid outcomes.
areas.no_go_trigger: Reference invalid, environment uncontrolled, data/IP rights unresolved, or compatibility dimension missing.
areas.pause_resume: Hold the part or instrument; resume with corrected method and professional review.

areas.role_in_system_zh: 公众报修、无障碍复测、人工放行与循环采购反馈
areas.role_in_system_en: Public intake, accessibility retest, accountable release, and procurement feedback
areas.acceptance_definition: Accountable plus independent sign-off within declared scope; essential service remains available.
areas.no_go_trigger: No staffed fallback, inaccessible public route, unresolved complaint, erasure failure, or incomplete gate trail.
areas.pause_resume: Keep the device out of public service; resume only after evidence closure and renewed sign-off.
